name: DRONE
description: Draw a card.

name: SLAVES FOR CHEAP
description: Gain a Drone.

name: UFO
description: Gain 1 Fear.

name: CONSPIRACY THEORIST
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion.

name: POWER WORD: STRENGTH
description: Play this card after any die roll, before the effect happens. Add +1 to the roll value.

name: THE GREAT AND POWERFUL
description: Roll the die. If 5 or more, gain 6 Fear. Otherwise, that sucks.

name: POWER WORD: CURSE
description: Name a number, roll the die. If you roll lower, self-inflict that number of suspicion. Otherwise, inflict the named number.

name: POWER WORD: MISSILE
description: Roll the Die. If 3 or more, inflict 4 suspicion. Otherwise, self-inflict 3 suspicion.

name: INCESSANT CHANTING
description: Roll the die until the sum of the rolls is higher than the current suspicion meter. Draw a card for each roll you did.

name: ARCANE WHISPERS
description: Gain 1 Fear.

name: HALLUCINATIONS
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion.

name: LOVELAND ALWAYS WINS
description: If you used a card to roll the die this turn, copy its effect.

name: TOIL AND TROUBLE
description: Roll the die. Gain Fear equal to half the roll's value, rounded down.

name: INTRUDER
description: Reveal a random main deck card, copy its effect, reshuffle the main deck.

name: A TERRIBLE OMEN
description: Gain a card that costs 4 or less.

name: POKER HAND TIME
description: If 4+ cards in the town have the same cost, reshuffle them into the main deck, and inflict suspicion equal to the amount of cards.

name: NOT GONE LOL
description: Reveal a random graveyard card, copy its effect.

name: LIGHT HOUSE
description: If 3 town cards have the same cost, and 2 others have a different cost, inflict 5 suspicion and reshuffle the town. Else, bury a town card.

name: FOLLOW THE LIGHT
description: When gained, bury this card, and gain the top 3 cards of the main deck.

name: BLINDING LIGHT
description: X is 1. Bury a town card that costs X and inflict X suspicion. You may repeat this card's effect, adding 1 to X, as much as you can.

name: ITS BACK BABY
description: Pick a graveyard card, copy its effect, shuffle it into the main deck.

name: EYES IN THE DARK
description: Gain 1 Fear.

name: TRICK OF THE LIGHT
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion.

name: SCOUT PREY
description: Pick a number. Gain 1 Fear for every town card with that cost, and shuffle those cards into the main deck.

name: LEARN AND GROW
description: Gain 1 Fear. You may bury a card from your hand to gain 1 Fear.

name: I MEAN SURE WHY NOT
description: Draw two cards, discard two cards.

name: GOD'S MOST PATHETIC CRIPPLE
description: Gain 1 Fear. If buried, inflict 2 suspicion.

name: JOLT OF ENERGY
description: Bury this card, draw two cards.

name: PATIENCE
description: Look at the top card of your deck, you may discard it. Draw a card.

name: LET'S RUN THROUGH THESE
description: Draw a card, bury a card in your hand.

name: CONFIRMATION BIAS
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion. If you already inflicted this turn, inflict 2 more.

name: CARD WHAT HELP YOU BOTH
description: Draw two cards, your opponent draws a card.

name: DOOMSAYER
description: Gain 2 Fear.

name: OPEN WARFARE
description: Gain 3 Fear and self-inflict 3 Suspicion.

name: HERD MENTALITY
description: Copy the effect of a card in your play area.

name: POISON THE WATER SUPPLY
description: Inflict 2 Suspicion.

name: PITCHFORKS AND TORCHES
description: For every two cards you've played this turn, inflict suspicion.

name: REVEL IN INFAMY
description: If the suspicion meter is aimed at you, gain fear equal to the meter's value. Else, inflict 2 suspicion.

name: LET'S GET THIS OVER WITH
description: Inflict 3 Suspicion. You may bury up to 2 cards in your discard pile. Inflict 1 suspicion for each.

name: AS IT WAS WRITTEN
description: Inflict 2 suspicion. Place a card from your discard pile in your hand.

name: CARD WHAT MORE DRAWS
description: Draw three cards.

name: BIG MONEY
description: Gain a card for free, place it at the top of your deck.

name: HYSTERIA
description: Inflict 4 suspicion.

name: INSATIABLE HUNGER
description: Gain 1 Fear. Bury a card in your hand or discard pile.

name: DEAD WEIGHT
description: When gained, place in opponent's discard pile. Does nothing.

name: ERASE, REPLACE
description: Copy the effect of a card in your play area, then bury it.

name: SMELLING BLOOD
description: Inflict 2 Suspicion. Bury a card in your hand to inflict 1 more.

name: GRAVEROBBING
description: Gain 2 Fear. This turn you may buy a card from the graveyard as if it were a town card.

name: CAUTIONARY TALES
description: Gain 1 Fear.

name: PLANTED EVIDENCE
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion.

name: AFTERTASTE
description: Copy the effect of a random card in the graveyard.

name: WINTER CHILL
description: If this card is chosen to be buried, it remains in your ownership.

name: SCOPOPHOBIA
description: Copy your character's ability for free.

name: FOLLOW MY VOICE
description: Self-inflict 1 suspicion, gain a drone.

name: HORDE
description: Discard all Drones in your hand, inflict 1 suspicion for each discarded.

name: SCOUT
description: For every Drone in your hand, draw a card.

name: GIVE IN
description: Bury a card in your discard pile, gain a Drone.

name: HOMOGENEITY
